description: This file defines OpenTelemetry semantic conventions and utility functions for HTTP attributes, status codes, and network attributes, specific to the v1.12.0 version of the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions.

methods.name: NetAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates network attributes for a given HTTP request and network type.

methods.name: EndUserAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates end-user attributes from an HTTP request.

methods.name: HTTPClientAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates HTTP client-side attributes from an HTTP request.

methods.name: HTTPServerMetricAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates low-cardinality server-side HTTP metrics attributes.

methods.name: HTTPServerAttributesFromHTTPRequest
methods.description: Generates server-side HTTP attributes, including route info.

methods.name: HTTPAttributesFromHTTPStatusCode
methods.description: Generates HTTP attributes based on status code.

methods.name: SpanStatusFromHTTPStatusCode
methods.description: Returns span status code and message based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: SpanStatusFromHTTPStatusCodeAndSpanKind
methods.description: Returns span status code and message considering span kind and HTTP status code.
